issue.title: BI分析を削除し、関連導線を整理する

summary: Remove BI analysis as a primary surface and intentionally redirect useful metric entry points to Dashboard/AI without deleting underlying data capability.
decisions: Issue #19 supersedes the current BI navigation requirement in REQUIREMENTS.md and DESIGN.md.
Remove the product route/navigation/CTA, not historical metrics storage needed by Dashboard, Agent, or reports.
Every old internal path has an explicit replacement or retirement behavior.
requirementRefs: DESIGN.md#2-アプリケーション構成

risks.description: Removing a screen could be mistaken for removing shared metric storage.
risks.mitigation: Prohibit destructive migration and retain Dashboard/Agent/report data paths.

risks.description: Help, chat, email, or bookmarks may still point at BI.
risks.mitigation: Inventory internal destinations and test redirect/retirement behavior.

gates.description: The issue is accepted as the new source of truth for main navigation.

acceptanceCriteria: BI analysis is absent from primary navigation and active product routes.
Useful BI entry points intentionally lead to Dashboard filters or contextual AI consultation.
Legacy links do not produce a blank or broken screen.
Metrics storage and Dashboard/Agent/report analysis continue unchanged.
REQUIREMENTS.md and DESIGN.md no longer require BI analysis.

rollback.strategy: Restore the prior route/navigation without changing metric storage.
rollback.verification: Dashboard, Agent, report, and legacy-link browser scenarios remain functional.
